user.title: Add a Knit device
user.description: Knit your sensors into a smart device. Its settings can also be changed on its Knit card.

menu_options.light: Light: on and off from your sensors (motion, door, vibration) and the light level
menu_options.auto_off_switch: Motion-controlled device: off once its sensors clear (they never turn it on)
menu_options.appliance: Appliance: running / full / empty from its power (a dishwasher, a washing machine)

light.title: Light
light.description:
Pick the light (or a plug-controlled light's switch) and the sensors it should follow.

Any on / off sensor works: motion or presence, a door or window contact (a cupboard light that's on while the door is open), a vibration sensor (a desk lamp that stays on while you're working), a doorbell (a porch light for a few minutes). Each can also be used the other way round: on while a door is closed, or while nothing is moving.

data.name: Name
data.presence_off: Sensors that turn it on while off (inverted)
data.pause: Pause while these are on (e.g. guests)
data.start_on: Turn its automatic features on now
data.brightness_managed: Brightness is managed by something else (for example Adaptive Lighting, or other automations)

data_description.presence: Motion, presence, a door or window contact, vibration: it's on while any of them is on (motion, open, vibrating), and counts down once they've all cleared. Leave both lists empty for no sensor control.
data_description.presence_off: The other way round: on while a door is closed, or while there's no motion or vibration. Leave empty if you don't need it.
data_description.illuminance: One or more. With several, their average is used, so a room without a sensor can follow the rooms around it.
data_description.pause: Knit leaves it alone while they're on: nothing turns it on or off by itself, and its card says Automations paused.
data_description.start_on: Leave this off if an automation already controls it, so the two don't both act on it.
data_description.pause_match: With several pause entities: any one of them on, or only once all of them are.
data_description.brightness_managed: Knit still dims the light as a warning before it goes off, but never sets a brightness of its own: it turns the light on plain, and after a dim it hands the brightness back (Adaptive Lighting is asked to take over again; without it, the brightness from before the dim is put back).

auto_off_switch.title: Motion-controlled device
auto_off_switch.description: A device that should go off once nobody's around: it's never turned on for you.

appliance.title: Appliance
appliance.description: A dishwasher, washing machine or dryer on a smart plug that reports power.

data_description.power: Its smart plug's power. Running once it's been above Running above for a while; finished once it's been below it for a while.
data_description.door: On = open. Open for a while once it's not drawing power: emptied.
data_description.empty_name: Its status once emptied (and before the first cycle).
data_description.running_name: Its status while a cycle runs.
data_description.full_name: Its status once a cycle has finished, until it's emptied.
